summary: Alternate capacity configurations the vehicle can adopt (the solver picks one).
range: Array of integer arrays; each inner array has the SAME dimension count as capacity. Cannot be shared/merged across vehicles.
constraints: Each inner array's length must equal capacity's dimension count.
businessRules: alternative_capacities defines: An array of alternate capacity configurations for the vehicle. Each array should have same number of dimensions as those configured when specifying task loads/quantities. Multiple arrays can also b…
Each element in alternative_capacities must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.capacity. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: two alt configs [[10],[20]] — solver adopts the one that fits demand.
Negative: an alt config with a different dimension count than capacity -> 400.
Interaction: Negative: capacity [10,100] but a job delivery [5] (1 dim vs 2) -> HTTP 400 input validation failed.
Interaction: Positive: capacity [10,100] with all deliveries/pickups/amounts 2-dimensional -> accepted.
Interaction: Consistency: alternative_capacities with different dimension than primary capacity -> HTTP 400.
Interaction: Consistency: min_stop_load [20,30] but capacity [10,100] only -> dimension mismatch HTTP 400.
